title: GPU utilization tiltmap — cluster & pool breakdown (Nov 14–20 2026)
content:
This sheet is an export used to build the tiltmap visualization for cluster/pool occupancy and short-window scheduling friction. Purpose: surface where steady-state utilization is high but effective throughput is low (i.e., high GPU util but high queue/low slot efficiency).

CSV rows (date, cluster, pool, avg_gpu_util_pct, p95_gpu_util_pct, median_queue_len, avg_active_slots, total_slots, headroom_pct, tilt_index, notes)

2026-11-14,cluster-alpha,pool-dedicated-ml,61,89,0,32,48,33,0.58,ramping for nightly batch

Derived columns (computed client-side):
- headroom_pct = (total_slots - avg_active_slots) / total_slots * 100 (reported as integer)
- tilt_index = (p95_gpu_util_pct / 100) * (1 + median_queue_len/4) * (1 + max(0,(80 - headroom_pct))/50)
  (heuristic used to rank hot-but-fragile pools; >1.2 triggers review)

Observations and quick notes: 
- cluster-beta/pool-spot shows repeated high tilt_index spikes across the week with p95 near 100 and queue lengths 6–9. Suspect two contributors: short heavy batch jobs (02:30–04:00 UTC) and bursty PLG eval traffic.
- cluster-alpha/pool-spot-hp shows consistently high avg util but good headroom and lower queue; jitter appears tied to tail p95 bursts. Short-term mitigation: 5–10% slot reservation for interactive tier or enable fast-preempt on spot jobs during 00:00–06:00 UTC.
- cluster-delta/pool-ephemeral is a candidate for consolidation; <40% avg util across the week and low business-critical usage.
- cluster-gamma/pool-reserved underused; consolidate into alpha/dedicated if network locality allows.

Action items (owner in parens):
- SRE: run detailed pod-level profiling for cluster-beta between 02:00–05:00 UTC (Noah Rivera).
- Capacity: evaluate moving 8 slots from cluster-gamma reserved pool to alpha dedicated (Maya Chen).
- Scheduling: prototype preemption thresholds for spot pools in beta with backoff windows (Arjun Patel).
- Product: confirm whether PLG evals can be batched outside peak window or routed to dedicated buckets (Lydia Park).

Open questions / To-do backlog:
- Should tilt_index parameterization be per-cluster? current heuristic tuned cluster-wide; may need pool-specific weights.
- Add per-GPU temperature & MIG fragmentation columns in next export to correlate thermal throttling and occupancy inefficiencies.
- Determine SLA for p95 GPU util per pool class (interactive vs batch) and encode into router policies.

Raw charts referenced in sheet (local exports):

- timeseries_csv: /drive/exports/tiltmap/timeseries_nov14-20.csv

Notes to self: this export intentionally keeps queue metric small (median) — consider adding 95th queue length to better detect tail queuing. Will iterate after INFRA-1429 postmortem.

End of export.
